To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the combination of multiple kernels, each of which is based on a different feature, is superior to the use of any single kernel; (2) the use of multiple kernels, with each kernel based on a different set of features, is superior to a single kernel with multiple feature sets; and (3) the performance of the combination of multiple features can be further improved by learning the optimal weights of the multiple kernels.
(a) a large number of classes is a challenge for classification, (b) the best performance is obtained by combining multiple features, and (c) the combination of features can be learnt automatically.
